description: Read or change a Doctor conversation with version bsd-agent-doctor-v1 and an action; the individual Doctor tools omit version and action. For quote send {version: "bsd-agent-doctor-v1", action: "quote", commandKey, threadId, sequence, text}: commandKey is a new 16–120 character letters/digits/underscore/hyphen key, reused on retry; threadId is the owned thread UUID; sequence is its current integer sequence (read action conversation); text is the question. Optional responseStyle applies only to this reply. Show the quote and get the customer’s yes, then start with {version: "bsd-agent-doctor-v1", action: "start", commandKey: a new key, quoteId: the quote id}. Remember or forget a note only when explicitly asked. Read the saved result before relaying an answer.

commandKey.description: Stable key for one write action and all its retries.

id.description: Exact owned note ID to remove.

responseStyle.description: This reply only. Omit to preserve the account default.
